verdict.rationale: BigCommerce's first-party docs say its API Reference has a built-in Request Runner for experimenting with the REST Management APIs, and the developer portal lists an in-browser API Request Runner. That is an interactive reference where requests can be run from the page. Missing for 10: evidence that the runner covers the GraphQL Storefront API, detail on prefilled runnable examples per endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can experiment with our REST Management APIs using the **Request Runner**, which is built in to the [API Reference]
